title: A screen can hug what it holds
goal: A screen (a frame you draw to build UI on) that arranges its contents in a row or a column keeps the size it was drawn, whatever goes in or comes out. The auto-layout mock gives a frame a size of Hug or a fixed number, and the UI epic is done only when a frame resizes around what it holds. Give a screen that choice on its Width and Height, the same Hug rows a group already has, so dropping a component into a hugging screen grows it and taking one out shrinks it. A screen you drew by hand stays the size you drew until you pick Hug.
notes: Manager review 2026-10-08 of ui-building. Today: Sources/PhotonzCore/GroupLayout.swift width/height doc says Ignored on a screen; Sources/Photonz/ArrangementInspector.swift around line 255 hides the size rows when the pick holds a screen (offersASizeOfItsOwn). docs/design/ui-building.md around line 2542 calls hug for a screen deliberate (a runner note, never a decision of the user; the reason, that something hanging off its edge must never resize it, is kept by offering Hug only on an arranged screen and never by default). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-autolayout.html Frame size segmented Hug (lines ~281-301, status text Frame hugs its content). Epic success: ui-building a) and ui-layout 1. Flags: next-auto-layout, on at Next defaults. Mock draws it, so no card.
acceptance: A screen that arranges its contents (row or column) shows Width and Height with Hug and a fixed number, as a group does today and as ui-autolayout.html draws its Frame size row
With Hug picked, adding, removing or resizing a child grows and shrinks the screen around its contents plus padding, and the change is one undo step
A screen left on a fixed size, and every screen in a saved document, behaves exactly as today (nil stays fixed for screens, so old files open unchanged)
A free screen (no arrangement) offers no Hug, so something hanging off its edge never resizes it

Tests first in PhotonzCore (GroupHugTests or a sibling); a walk at Next defaults draws a screen, turns on Column, picks Hug, drags a component from the Library into it and checks the screen grew, then deletes it and checks it shrank

Side by side with ui-autolayout.html Frame size row in the audit. Try: New Window, Blank canvas, draw a screen, Layout section, Column, Width Hug, then drop a Button from the Library into it. Audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not

log.note: Pre-build review: a person from Figma expects Hug on an auto-layout frame's W/H; the app's Width/Height Hug|Fixed rows are the same control a group already has. Risks: an empty hugging screen would collapse to padding (decided: an empty screen holds its last size, there is nothing to hug); dragging or typing a size on a hugging axis should turn that axis Fixed, as a group does. Storage: two new flags on the layout (written only when on) so every saved screen opens fixed.

Built: GroupLayout.screenHugsWidth/Height (written only when on), GroupFlow resizes a hugging arranged screen's frame from its top left, Layer.resized turns a hugged axis Fixed on a hand/typed size, ContentsSelection.offersHug + hug readings, ArrangementInspector shows Width/Height on arranged screens (no limits, no clip row). ScreenHugTests (13) + full suite 11856 green. Walk a-screen-hugs-what-it-holds-walk green at Next defaults with 5 real captures: empty 400x300 holds, Button -> 78x36, Card -> 260x219, delete -> 78x36, undo -> 260x219, Fixed + H 400 -> 260x400.

Left rough (not filed): in the walk, the Delete key after selectRow did nothing while the Position and Size popover was still open; Edit > Delete worked. Not reproduced as a person would do it (a real click on a row closes the popover), so it stays here. Also: the Position and Size popover's white title on light grey glass looked faint in the capture; existing surface, not touched here. Empty screen made into a column starts at 0 padding so a hugging screen sits flush on its contents; in the audit rough for the user to react to. Mock difference (one Frame size row vs Width/Height) filed as the-size-rows-in-the-layout-section-match-the-au with a decision card.

A screen set to Stack (row/column) or Grid offers Width and Height Hug|Fixed like a group; Hug closes the screen around its contents and padding, add/remove/resize is one undo step, saved screens open fixed, free screens never hug. Core in GroupLayout/GroupFlow/ContentsSelection/AnnotationEditing, rows in ArrangementInspector. ScreenHugTests + full suite (11856) green; a-screen-hugs-what-it-holds-walk green at Next defaults with 5 real captures. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-08-screen-hug.json.
